concepts.gloss_en: The rectification of the aspect of the 'zaken' (elder/beard), achieved through charity; here equated (via שהוא) with the aspect of Shavuot

members.form: נתתקן בחינת זקן שׁהוא בחינת שׁבועות

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the same clause in lm2:4 ('the aspect of the zaken is rectified'), one captured bare and two with the appositive 'שהוא בחינת שבועות'. The Shavuot phrase is just an equation edge (שהוא) tacked onto the identical concept, not a separate concept, so all merge under one canonical form. Same word, same passage — no homograph or archetype/generic issue.
